stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 note [--ref=<ref>] [-f] <command> [--] [<args>...]

Manage notes attached to objects.

Subcommands:
    add <object> <message>        Add a note to an object
    show <object>                 Show the note for an object
    list                          List notes
    remove <object>               Remove the note for an object

Options:
    <command>
        the subcommand (add, show, list, remove)
    --ref=<ref>
        notes reference to use
    -f, --force
        overwrite an existing note when adding
    <args>...
        arguments for the subcommand
